name: FOMC pre-announcement reversal ES

source.title: The FOMC Announcement Reversal
source.type: SSRN working paper; accessible chapter in 2023 Insper thesis

session: Scheduled FOMC day, usual 13:50–15:50 paper clock; eight historical 12:30 releases use 12:15 entry and 14:15 exit
mandatory_same_session_close: Close two hours later using opposing bid/ask, before the cash close; zero-return treatment not stated.
max_entry_rule_origin: Selected research specification; one initial entry, no same-day re-entry. This cap is not an observed frequency.
observed_trade_frequency: FOMC event count, not daily average

source_rules.indicator: Prior 24-hour ES return at the paper pre-release entry minute: mid_t / mid_at_same_clock_previous_day − 1.
source_rules.buy: On scheduled FOMC day, buy ES at ask if prior 24-hour return is negative.
source_rules.sell_short: On scheduled FOMC day, sell ES at bid if prior 24-hour return is positive.
source_rules.exit: Close two hours later using opposing bid/ask, before the cash close; zero-return treatment not stated.
source_rules.position_sizing: Notional/contract sizing and max loss are not specified.
source_rules.cost_treatment: Original uses ask for buys and bid for sells at minute-close observations; explicitly ignores broker fees and market impact.

source_reported_performance: Table 1.2: 180 events, mean 17.86 basis points per event after bid/ask, annualized event Sharpe 1.02; Table 1.8 109 early events mean 14.30 bp, Table 1.9 71 later events mean 23.34 bp. These are author subsamples, not untouched OOS.
independent_evidence_note: No independent or post-2020 test; source-period splits do not count as independent OOS.
known_risks: Announcement jumps, rapid quote changes, order rejection/impact, no protective stop; high event concentration.
data_requirements: Exact-dated ES M1 bid/ask or tick quotes, scheduled FOMC timestamps, historical release-time exceptions, exchange/DST calendar and contract roll.
proposed_adaptations_not_source_validate: Resolve source EST/ET wording against each historic FOMC timestamp; skip zero-return events by a predeclared rule; cap one event position; fixed contract sizing and news slippage stress are new assumptions.

research_score.meaning: Research priority judgment; not probability of profitability

evidence_status: Working paper, author event result after bid/ask
special_case: Eight historical 12:30 releases use 12:15 entry and 14:15 exit; verify timestamps and source EST/ET convention before implementation. Zero-return rule is unresolved.
